verses.text: For the music director, on an instrument from Gath. A psalm by the sons of Korah. What a beautiful place you live in, LORD of Armies!
I’m aching to be in the LORD’s courts. My heart and my whole body cry out for the living God.
Even a sparrow has found a home, and a swallow has built a nest for her young near your altars, LORD of Armies, my King and my God.
Blessed are those who live in your house. They never stop praising you. Selah.
Blessed are those who get their strength from you and set their hearts on the journey to your house.
When they pass through the Valley of Weeping, they turn it into a place of springs. The autumn rain covers it with blessings.
They grow stronger as they go, until every one of them stands before God in Zion.
LORD God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen to me, God of Jacob. Selah.
God, our shield, look with favor on the face of your anointed one.
One day in your courts beats a thousand anywhere else. I’d rather stand at the door of my God’s house than live in the tents of the wicked.
The LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD gives grace and glory. He holds back nothing good from those who live with integrity.
LORD of Armies, blessed is anyone who trusts you.
